title: 1982 AHSME Problem 8
statement: By definition \(r!=r(r-1)\cdots1\) and \(\binom jk=\frac{j!}{k!(j-k)!},\) where \(r,\) \(j,\) \(k\) are positive integers and \(k\lt j.\) If \(\binom n1,\) \(\binom n2,\) \(\binom n3\) form an arithmetic progression with \(n\gt3,\) then \(n\) equals

solutions.text:
The progression condition is \(2\binom n2=\binom n1+\binom n3.\) Substitution and cancellation give \(n^2-9n+14=0,\) or \((n-2)(n-7)=0.\) Since \(n\gt3,\) \(n=7.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is B.
